rules.title: Prompt and context limits are explicit
rules.check: Prompt or context contract is oversized, duplicated, or missing explicit limits.
rules.evidence: Redacted prompt structure and length measurements.
rules.claimBoundary: Heuristic only; prompt body is never reproduced.
rules.remediation: State bounded context and output budgets in the review contract.
rules.verification: Compare imported token usage before and after a controlled change.
rules.falsePositiveBoundary: A large prompt may be justified by a measured quality gain.

rules.title: Findings require evidence and uncertainty
rules.check: Prompt lacks evidence, verification, or uncertainty requirements.
rules.claimBoundary: Heuristic only; wording does not prove runtime behavior.
rules.remediation: Require evidence, verification status, and explicit uncertainty for each finding.
rules.verification: Adjudicate imported findings against the versioned rubric.
rules.falsePositiveBoundary: Equivalent requirements can be enforced by a separately declared tool contract.

rules.title: Unverified findings are pruned before publishing
rules.check: Prompt or telemetry lacks validation or pruning before publishing findings.
rules.claimBoundary: Static prompt evidence alone cannot establish hallucination rate.
rules.remediation: Require a deterministic verification gate and suppress unverified findings.
rules.verification: Compare validator outcomes with adjudicated finding labels.
rules.falsePositiveBoundary: A declared external validator may enforce the gate.

rules.title: Comment noise is bounded
rules.check: No comment budget, deduplication, or suppression rule is visible.
rules.evidence: Prompt, workflow, and optional telemetry structure.
rules.claimBoundary: Static indicator only; actual noise needs publish telemetry.
rules.remediation: Set a maximum comment count, deduplicate, and suppress unverified findings.
rules.verification: Measure proposed and published counts in imported telemetry.
rules.falsePositiveBoundary: A separately declared publisher can enforce a budget.
